description: Constant stack allocations on either side of the CWE-789 threshold (cwe_checker's default 7500 bytes): 4096 bytes (good.elf) and 16384 bytes (bad.elf).

cases.reason: 'sub sp, sp, #4096' is a constant allocation below the 7500-byte threshold, so the excessive-allocation finding does not hold.
'sub sp, sp, #16384' allocates more than the 7500-byte threshold in one frame.
